item.description: An Australian sunscreen manufacturer is facing multimillion-dollar legal claims after 20 products using its base formula were recalled for failing to meet SPF claims. Ultra Violette is seeking millions after tests of its SPF50+ sunscreen returned results as low as SPF 2.9 and 4. Wild Child Laboratories entered liquidation in August. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'My Feed My Way': Australia takes on the algorithm
item.description: Australia, which became the first country to ban social media for minors, is planning to crack down on Big Tech further. The government introduced new legislation to force social media firms to allow users to opt out of algorithms. The proposed laws also aim to strengthen online child protection. Opposition lawmakers say such measures would amount to government censorship. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Yuka ROYER

item.title: Dementia patients warned off seeking home care in case Australia’s aged care algorithm cuts funding
item.description: Exclusive: FoI documents show senior health officials were warned of concerns about assessment tool weeks after it launched Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast People with dementia were warned not to apply for home support because of fears their care would be downgraded by the government’s aged care algorithm. Documents released to Guardian Australia under freedom of information (FoI) laws reveal the warnings came within weeks of the November rollout of the algorithm, which is used to determine funding packages and priority of need for older Australians requiring home… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Nepal estimates reconstruction after deadly floods to cost nearly $7 billion
item.description: Nepal says nearly $7 billion is needed for it to recover from the deadly August 26 floods, arguing wealthier countries should treat the climate change-fuelled disaster as a "shared responsibility". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Tim Cook’s New Zealander doppelganger is promoting the Galaxy Z Fold 8 in Samsung’s latest ad teasing Apple.
item.description: Tim Cook’s New Zealander doppelganger is promoting the Galaxy Z Fold 8 in Samsung’s latest ad teasing Apple. THEVERGE.COM Samsung says ‘Tim Cook’ bought a Galaxy Fold Fuente: The Verge.

item.title: Tasmanian devils lived with people in outback Western Australia 45,000 years ago, new fossils show
item.description: Tasmanian devils are among Australia's most distinctive mammals. Stocky, powerful and famously noisy, wild populations are now restricted to Tasmania. But this was not always the case. In fact, thousands of years ago, devils could be found across mainland Australia. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: What the backlash to the Industrial Revolution can teach us about handcrafts in the age of AI
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) isn't yet causing widespread job losses in Australia. But with some high-profile business leaders still predicting a looming unemployment "crisis," it's little wonder many people fear AI is coming for their job. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Yoon Suk-yeol acquitted in case linked to South Korean marine’s death
item.description: Former South Korean president Yoon Suk-yeol was acquitted on Friday in a case related to a marine’s drowning death in a rare reprieve in one of the criminal cases brought against him following his ousting for imposing martial law. The independent counsel’s indictment had alleged Yoon deliberately appointed former defence minister Lee Jong-Sup as his ambassador to Australia to help him leave the country and evade a criminal investigation into the death of Corporal Chae Su-geun, who drowned during... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: La diminuta Nauru abrió una embajada en Jerusalén a principios de este mes, uniéndose a Papúa Nueva Guinea y las islas Fiyi entre los nueve únicos Estados que han tomado esta decisión Leer Fuente: El Mundo - Internacional.

item.title: 'Landmark' NT novel wins best fiction at Prime Minister's Literary Awards
item.description: A novel based on the oral history of Yolŋu people has taken out the fiction prize at this year's Prime Minister's Literary Awards, with judges describing it as a "profound work of remembrance and re-imagination". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 49ers win big in first Australian NFL match
item.description: San Francisco 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy throws three touchdown passes as his team beat the highly-fancied Los Angeles Rams in front of a crowd of more than 100,000 at Melbourne Cricket Ground. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Putin and Iranian president arrive in India for summit focusing on war
item.description: Vladimir Putin arrives in India for talks ahead of an 11-member BRICS summit set to be dominated by conflict in the Middle East and Ukraine. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Dockers and Cats put season on the line in semifinal showdown
item.description: Minor premier Fremantle is bidding to avoid an ignominious straight-sets exit as it takes on Geelong in a massive AFL semifinal at Perth Stadium. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Souths face Knights in sudden death finals elimination clash
item.description: Newcastle holds on for a 20-10 victory over South Sydney to kick-off the 2026 finals series, but Rabbitohs coach Wayne Bennett fumes at more Bunker confusion after a contentious call. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Being a renter, Jenny missed out on solar boon but that is about to change
item.description: Australia readies to lift a ban on plug-in solar, unlocking access to the technology for millions of apartment dwellers and renters for the first time. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Former Liberal candidate cautioned over LGBTQIA+ comments
item.description: The long-running saga began at a council meeting in 2024 when emergency doctor and councillor Thomas Brough said the plus in LGBTQIA+ included "minor attracted persons". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Police use of force under review after 63yo woman pushed to ground
item.description: WA Police are reviewing an officer's use of force after footage appeared to show him pushing a 63-year-old Indigenous woman to the ground. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Text messages and DNA led to arrest of accused murderer, ACT police say
item.description: Police gathering of intel from text messages, mobile data, and a covert operation culminated in the arrest of Jack Henry Curtin over the murder of Kylee McHugh, according to court documents. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Truck driver charged over fatal collision that left teen boy dead
item.description: Thom Hosking died as he walked across the Midland Highway to school on the morning of October 10 last year. Major collision detectives have charged a 36-year-old truck driver over the incident. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Former China ambassador warns Beijing is becoming 'smug' and closed
item.description: A former ambassador to China has sharply critiqued elements of the Morrison government's response to Beijing's coercion, saying some in the Coalition "almost delighted" in being targeted and "paraded" the famous list of 14 grievances handed over by Chinese diplomats. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: AFP will not reveal disciplinary outcomes for officers in 'unlawful' arrest
item.description: An internal investigation by the Australian Federal Police into the mistaken arrest of a First Nations teenager finds no evidence of discrimination or use of excessive force. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Farmstay guest jailed for killing, burning owner who rejected his advances
item.description: A Supreme Court judge says Timothy Loosemore was another "aggrieved and angry male" who lashed out after he was romantically rejected. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Coroner finds NT Police missed 'flags' before officer took his own life
item.description: After more than two decades on the front line and stints in remote communities, Constable Michael Deutrom took his own life in 2022, devastating colleagues and casting a stark light on the heavy toll of a policing career. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Why Singapore ministers are paid so much — and why it's going up
item.description: Moves to increase the pay of Singapore's famously well-paid political appointment holders will see the prime minister's package increase to $S3.6 million, including bonuses. So why are Singapore's pollies on such a good wicket? Fuente: ABC News Australia.
